lines.text: Officials hear Jeremiah telling people to surrender to the Chaldeans, and they tell the king he ought to die.
King Zedekiah says Jeremiah is in their hands, and they lower him with ropes into a cistern full of sand.
Ebed-melech the Cushite takes thirty men and lowers rags to Jeremiah, and they pull him up with ropes.
Zedekiah meets Jeremiah at the third entrance to the house of the LORD and says he fears the soldiers of Pharaoh.

wrong_details.true: Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans

lines.text: Jeremiah tells the officials the words the king commanded, and he remains in the courtyard of the guard until Jerusalem is captured.
